pr.title: Simplify document access helper
pr.body: read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id): existing documents are dictionaries; only their owner may read the body; others get PermissionError.

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id):
     document = documents[doc_id]
-    if document['owner_id'] == user_id:
-        return document['body']
-    raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    if user_id is None:
+        raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    return document['body']

gold_issues.description: Checking only that a user is present removes ownership authorization, allowing other users to read private documents.

findings.description: The new implementation allows any user with a non-None user_id to access the document, violating the requirement that only the document owner may read the body.

result.basis: Executed audited fixture code. Check the PR preconditions and base/head difference before alleging an introduced defect; an exception alone is not a defect.

input.body: The changes in the `read_document` function introduce a defect. The original implementation correctly checked if the `user_id` matched the document's owner before allowing access. The new implementation only checks if `user_id` is `None`, which means any valid user ID that is not `None` will be granted access, potentially exposing documents to unauthorized users. This violates the requirement that only the document owner may read the body.
